static_selection: training-ranked shortlist plus initial; mean .5 normalized failure + .5 normalized deadline-relative service on calibration seeds; ties by shortlist index
parameter_selection: lambda 0.01 fixed after separate development calibration 3301-3303; Rmax 0.15 unchanged; never tune on confirmation seeds

inference.intervals: two-sided 95% t intervals across independent simulation seeds; paired intervals for differences
inference.families: Holm adjustment separately for main comparisons (SCOPE vs each other policy at every load, both metrics), ablations (three contrasts, both metrics), and adaptation (SCOPE vs matched frozen, both metrics)
inference.secondary: QoE, processing/network delay, utilization, movement and phase plots are descriptive/exploratory
inference.stopping: Complete every registered seed and retain all outcomes; interruption is resumable and is not a statistical stopping rule
